goal: Make campaign schema and record upgrades explicit without inventing legacy reference coverage
asset: Existing packet input closure and shared safe tightening precondition
scope: Legacy reference lock diagnostics and record compatibility
outOfScope: Silently adding reference coverage to historical identities

record.question: How should runner configuration and check input paths be distinguished?

options.strongest_objection: Unrecognized directory-valued options need --path or harnessInputs to bind actual inputs
Runner root settings silently lock unrelated repository files

record.rationale: Skip directory option values unless explicitly declared as input paths. Resolve harness bash through the existing cross-platform helper.
evidence: Issue #208 reproduction seeds unrelated files through --rootdir=.
Issue #217 identifies CreateProcess System32 search before PATH

costs.cost: Small option classification and regression coverage
evidence: Existing PATH_FLAGS distinguishes explicit input options

costs.cost: Whole repository input drift and Windows failures

requirements.statement: Old schema fields required by emitted guards fail compilation with migration context; genuine legacy identities can be recorded with explicit missing-reference coverage and explicit unpinned allowances
requirements.counterexample: Missing TreeCheckV1.root compiles or unchanged archive is reported edited after lock format upgrade

checks.scope: Actual compiler validation and spec/record CLIs exercise legacy formats and unchanged/changed packet bytes
assumptions: Historical references were unbound and cannot be reconstructed retroactively

challenges.claim: Should positional directories also be skipped?
challenges.resolution: No, positional paths and PATH_FLAGS remain explicit inputs; only option values naming directories are skipped.
